requirement: Add three pricing helpers, each in its own module with its own test file. (1) taxFor(amount, ratePercent) in src/tax.js, returning the tax rounded to cents, tested in tests/tax.test.js. (2) formatPrice(amount) in src/format.js, returning a dollar string with two decimals, tested in tests/format.test.js. (3) priceLabel(amount, ratePercent) in src/label.js, using the other two to return the taxed price followed by ' incl. tax', tested in tests/label.test.js.
